fact: A second Earth-sized world in TOI-700's habitable zone, found three years after the first.
bio: TOI-700 e, confirmed in 2023, is a rocky, roughly Earth-sized planet orbiting within the habitable zone just inside its sibling TOI-700 d. Finding two temperate Earth-sized worlds in one nearby system made TOI-700 an especially rich target for future studies of small-planet atmospheres.
